title: 第一卷 第1章 本尊回来辣第一卷 第2章 本尊被顶替了
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
“天杀的，小魔童找到我们第二百四十八处新家了！”
“快跑啊——”
无数魔族卷着包袱，拖家带口地朝着远方狂奔，卷起尘埃滚滚。
“不许跑！本尊还没打完呢！”
一道奶声奶气的怒喝响起，紧接着一道冲击波荡开，方圆百里的魔族全都哎呦哎呦地摔倒在地。
他们腿骨倒没断，但每个人的膝盖上都多了几个小脚印——那是被某个小团子跳起来踹的。
一群活了上千年的老魔头，被一个六岁小女娃踹得抱膝打滚，画面又凶又好笑。
眼看身后杀红了眼的小团子越来越近，魔族们流下了悔恨的泪水。
早知道她成长得这般快，在她刚进万魔幡的时候，他们就不欺负她，而是把她当祖宗供起来了。
十年。
整整十年啊！
这小祖宗从当初被他们追着跑的受气包，变成了追着他们跑的小魔头。
魔族数量没少多少，但每个魔都被她揍过至少三遍——第一遍是报仇，第二遍是“本尊忘了上次打没打过你”，第三遍是“本尊路过顺手”。
其中一个老魔族望着灰暗天空，用古魔语凄厉祈求：
“万魔的至高之主，伟大的上古魔神，快救救您水深火热的族人……”
洛还真一把揪住老魔族的触须（因为他的衣领全是触须抓不住），歪着脑袋盯着他长满触须却还不停蠕动的嘴——
这个坏魔爷爷在叽里咕噜说什么呢？听不懂。
不过肯定又是在说本尊坏话！
她鼓起腮帮子正要发作，刹那间，头顶一阵轰鸣。
洛还真抬起头，看见灰霾的天空缓缓浮现出一个巨大的虚影——是一面巨大的旗。

旗子的虚影越来越凝实，一道威严而肃杀的声音从旗帜中传出：“族人以上古密咒唤我是为何事……”
下方所有魔族都跪地不起，用魔族语对着万魔幡凄厉哭泣，字字泣血：
“魔主醒了！！”
“魔主，您吸了一个小祖宗进到我们的家园啊！”
“求魔主，快把这小瘟神送走！！”
“救救您的族人！我们的膝盖都快被她踹碎啦！”
在一声声的哭泣与哀求中，万魔幡轻轻飘动。
“允。”
旗帜中心出现一个玄奥的漩涡，巨大的吸力从漩涡中传出。
“本尊不回去！本尊要找大师兄！本尊还没打完呢！！！”
洛还真拳打脚踢地在虚无中大叫，两条小短腿蹬得像风车一样，但是却无人回应她。
她被漩涡吸了进去，像一颗小土豆被冲进了下水道。
在翻滚中，她脑子里突然闪过一个想法。
洛还真贼兮兮地自言自语：“本尊滴血认主试试……”
这旗子也算是法器吧？师尊教过，好法器要滴血认主！
她在旗内世界里翻滚着，咬破自己的小手指头，往虚空中到处乱抹。
“本尊的血给你！以后你就是本尊的旗子啦！”
万魔幡内：
“啊！等等，这小瘟神在做什么！”
“这是我们魔主的本命法器，不能被她契约走，谁快阻止她啊！她手指头上全是血！”

“魔主、魔主呢！”
content_en:
"Damn it, the little devil boy has found our 248th new home!"
"Run quickly——"
Countless demons rolled up their burdens and ran towards the distance, dragging their families with them, kicking up dust.
"Don't run! I haven't finished the fight yet!"
A roar of anger rang out, followed by a shock wave, and all the demons within a hundred miles fell to the ground.
Their leg bones were not broken, but there were a few small footprints on each of their knees - they were kicked by some little guy.
A group of old demons who have lived for thousands of years were kicked to the knees by a six-year-old girl. The scene was both fierce and funny.
Seeing the red-eyed Xiaotuanzi behind them getting closer and closer, the demons shed tears of regret.
If they had known that she would grow up so fast, they would not have bullied her when she first entered Ten Thousand Demon Banners, but would have treated her as an ancestor.
ten years.
A whole ten years!
This little ancestor went from being a doormat chased by them to a little devil chasing them.
The number of demons is not much smaller, but each demon has been beaten by her at least three times - the first time is revenge, the second time is "I forgot whether I beat you last time", and the third time is "I just happened to be passing by."
One of the old demons looked at the gray sky and prayed sternly in ancient demon language:
"Supreme Lord of all demons, great ancient demon god, please save your people who are in dire straits..."
Luo Huanzhen grabbed the old demon's tentacles (because his collar was full of tentacles and couldn't be grasped), tilted his head and stared at his tentacled but still squirming mouth——
What is this evil grandfather talking about? Can't understand.
But he must be speaking ill of me again!
She puffed up her cheeks and was about to have an attack, when suddenly there was a roar above her head.
Luo Huazhen raised his head and saw a huge shadow slowly emerging from the gray sky - a huge flag.
The shadow of the flag became more and more solid, and a majestic and solemn voice came from the flag: "Why are my people calling me with the ancient secret curse..."
All the demons below knelt down and cried miserably to the Ten Thousand Demon Flags in the demon language, crying blood every word:
"The Demon Lord is awake!!"
"Devil Lord, you sucked a little ancestor into our home!"
"Please Demon Lord, send this little plague god away quickly!!"
"Save your people! Our knees are about to be kicked to pieces by her!"
Amid the cries and pleas, the demonic flags fluttered gently.
"Yun."
A mysterious vortex appeared in the center of the flag, and a huge suction force came from the vortex.
"I won't go back! I want to find my senior brother! I haven't finished fighting yet!!!"
Luo Huanzhen punched, kicked and screamed in the void, her two short legs kicked like windmills, but no one responded to her.
She was sucked into the vortex, like a small potato being washed into the sewer.
While rolling, an idea suddenly flashed through her mind.
Luo Huan said to himself in a really treacherous manner: "I will try to identify my master by dripping my blood..."
This flag can also be considered a magical weapon, right? Master has taught me that a good magical weapon must shed blood to identify its owner!
She rolled around in the world inside the banner, biting her little finger and smearing it everywhere in the void.
"I give you my blood! From now on, you will be my flag!"
Inside the Ten Thousand Demon Banners:
"Ah! Wait, what is this little plague god doing!"
"This is our Demon Lord's natal magic weapon. She cannot be contracted away. Someone stop her! Her fingers are full of blood!"
"The Demon Lord, where is the Demon Lord!"
